$comment: Block definitions of the built-in `dwell` namespace (docs/BLOCK_REGISTRY.md). Run `node shared/blocks/gen.mjs` after editing; CI fails if the generated files are stale. Blocks take runtime state ids in this order, each block's states in property order (keys alphabetical, the last key varying fastest, values in declared order). Air must come first (id 0). `fluids` are the named fluid looks (docs/BLOCK_REGISTRY.md, 'Fluid looks') that blocks with `"look": "fluid"` reference by name; a fluid block's opacity is its fluid's. The content is prototype (ARCHITECTURE.md §6.1).
$rampFamilies: Half-height grid (Phase 41, docs/HALF_HEIGHT_GRID.md): each listed natural block gets `<name>_ramp[facing, flooded, half, shape]`, the stored cardinal ramps the generator places (shape ramp, steep_lower, steep_upper). Natural blocks are not adaptive on this grid: shapes are chosen once, at generation. Their `flooded` (as on main) marks a block the sea's water stands in: a ramp below sea level holds it in its open part (WATER_RENDERING.md §9).
$lights: Light sources (docs/LIGHTS.md §2): the dynamic point lights that blocks reference by name (`light`), held in a hand or placed. color (sRGB), strength (its irradiance at the flame), radiusM (where it ends; a placed torch's block light reaches `emits` metres, so the same radius lights alike), flicker (amount: the share of its strength it takes at most; speed: its noise's cycles a second), shadows (whether it may cast them, the Torch shadows setting's, Phase 47 T2), flame (optional: the flame look drawn where it burns, a name in shared/look/flames.json; docs/LIGHTS.md §6). A placed block's flood light is its `emits`; a held one never touches the flood light.

blocks.name: dirt
blocks.$comment: sideUnder: a dirt side face with grass (or snowy grass) directly above (a slope's low side at a step or cliff) shows the turf's (or the snow's) skirt hanging over its top edge (docs/PAINTERLY_TEXTURES.md §2).

blocks.name: ladder
blocks.$comment: Drawn cutout: the ladder tile's gaps between rails and rungs are transparent. selectionBox: aimed at by its plate, ⅛ m against the wall it is mounted on (written for facing north and turned per facing), not the whole cell.

blocks.name: water
blocks.$fillProperty: How full the cell is, in eighths (docs/WATER_FLOW.md §15): a basin's top row is written at its level's fill, so water rises and falls smoothly; generated and placed water is full.
blocks.$lightFilter: Flood light (docs/DAY_NIGHT.md §11): each ½ m of water takes a level off the sky light under it.

blocks.name: sand
blocks.$drops: Owner, 2026-11-14: "Yeah sand should have sub chunks.": a ½ m cell breaks into 8 sand clumps, as dirt into dirt clumps; 8 make sand again (shared/inventory recipes).
blocks.$settlesAs: Owner, 2026-11-13: "gravity blocks like sand settling ... shouldn't settle ramps away from other blocks they should transform into flat blocks": a fallen sand ramp (its family falls too) settles as full sand.

blocks.$comment: The structure sandbox's ground (prototype, docs/STRUCTURES.md §7.6): white with a faint line at every block edge (the `grid` tile) and a stronger one every 8 blocks (the `grid` look option), not in the palette, and indestructible so it can always be built on. Not adaptive: it stays flat cubes.
blocks.name: sandbox_floor

blocks.$comment: A trunk or branch (docs/FELLING.md): a carrier, holding up the leaves on it while a path of logs reaches the ground, and falling when cut off. Its axis turns its end grain (top, bottom) to face along it, so a felled trunk lies along x or z. breakWith (shared/tools, ADR 0067; owner, 2026-11-08): where blocks are not unlimited (adventure), hands can't break it: an axe chops it. leafFlush (WORK_QUEUE item 48; owner, 2026-11-12: "Flat leaf applied when a full Face touching"): a leaf beside it lies flat against it, no chamfer on that side (docs/TREE_GROWTH.md §10). joined (BUGS.md #204; owner, 2026-11-17: "logs shouldn't adapt when blocks break around them"): auto (the default) joins the neighbouring logs as they stand; when a neighbour breaks the server stores the sides it was joined on (0–15, the four sides across its axis), so a 2×2 trunk's quarter keeps its shape.
blocks.name: log

crossSection.$comment: ADR 0072 (owner, 2026-11-09: "trees should be octagons around. But smoothly connect when placed next to each other, full width sides where they meet"): a regular octagon across its axis (chamfer 1/(2+√2) of the side); a side squares off to full width where a log of the same axis lies on it. ring/heart (Phase 55 T3; owner, 2026-11-09: "the outside bark ring should follow the octagon"): the caps' bark band follows the octagon's edges, none along a joined side, with the ringless end grain inside.

widths.$comment: ADR 0079 (owner, 2026-11-11: "trees start with small trunks, thin"): a standing log's octagon in ¼ m steps, centred in its cell; width 4 is the full log (the default, as before). A narrower log joins nothing; a lying one is drawn full width.

blocks.$comment: Drawn cutout: the leaves tile has transparent gaps between the leaves. lightFilter: a canopy dims the sky light under it rather than shutting it out (docs/DAY_NIGHT.md §11). A rider (docs/FELLING.md): held up by the logs it belongs to, holding nothing; passable: players walk through it (owner, 2026-10-27). flooded (ADR 0063; owner, 2026-11-07: "underwater leaves z fighting, I think they should be flooded"): under water the leaves hold it in their gaps, drawn as the water beside them.
blocks.name: leaves

blocks.$comment: Prototype content (docs/TRANSPARENT_BLOCKS.md §6): blades of grass, the first plant. No collision; crossed quads drawn cutout, jittered per cell, swaying in the wind and fading out before the LOD; placed by hand only (world generation doesn't grow it), on grass or dirt, replaced by what is placed into it, and gone with the block under it.
blocks.name: tall_grass
blocks.$drops: Owner, 2026-11-14: "grass fiber should be a guaranteed drop, seeds will be 50%" and "Cutting grass that's taller than 1 gives +1 plant fiber each": one fibre for each ½ m cell (a taller stand's cells go with the cell under them, each dropping its own), a seed at 50 %, at every stage; the gem from a full tuft as before. A stand up to 2 m (WORK_QUEUE item 58 g): its lower cells are stalks (`stage` `stalk`), each dropping its fibre; the seed and the gem come from its top cell only.

heights.$comment: Growth stages (docs/ECOLOGY.md §10, shared/worldgen/grass.json `stages`): a sprout (0) to full height (3, the default: tall grass placed, or saved before stages, is full). `stalk` is a lower cell of a stand up to 2 m (grass.json `height`): full blades drawn a third past the cell's top, so the cell above's blades rise out of them without a gap.

blocks.$placeOn: On tall grass too: a stand up to 2 m is a column of cells, each standing on the one under it, so cutting one takes the cells above it (WORK_QUEUE item 58 g).

blocks.$comment: The stored ramps (rampFamilies) at their own slots, as generated before the torch was added: blocks added after them keep every earlier state id (the worldgen goldens hash ids). Stone's are placeable: the hotbar's stone slopes (shared/items, owner 2026-10-30).
blocks.name: stone_ramp

blocks.$comment: Prototype content (docs/LIGHTS.md): a torch on the floor, 1 m tall over two ½ m cells. This is its lower cell (the stick), placed from the palette; `extends.up` puts `dwell:torch_upper` (the flame) in the cell above, and breaking either cell clears both (BLOCK_REGISTRY.md, Multi-cell blocks). Crossed quads, drawn cutout, no collision, standing on the block below and gone with it. Its `light` is the light a hand holding it gives off; a hand holding it shows the `torch` item (shared/characters).
blocks.name: torch

blocks.$comment: The torch's upper cell (docs/LIGHTS.md): the stick's top and the flame, which gives off the block light (`emits` 14, its cell the flame's) and, with Torch shadows (T2), the placed torch's dynamic light. Placed only with its torch (`partOf`).
blocks.name: torch_upper

blocks.$comment: The bedrock between the faces (docs/BIFACIAL_WORLD.md §2, owner 2026-10-21: "add bedrock back in between the two faces"): generated in the layers either side of the midplane (`shared/worldgen/terrain.json` `bedrock`), indestructible so no edit, region tool or brush cuts it; the faces meet only through the portals' shafts (`shared/worldgen/portals.json`). Not placeable.
blocks.name: bedrock

blocks.$comment: Snow lying on turf (owner, 2026-10-21: "add snow 'grass' block"): grass's counterpart on high ground, which the terrain generator tops columns with above the snow line (shared/worldgen/terrain.json `bands`). A white snow top, a side with the snow's fringe hanging over the dirt (the `hang` tile, as grass's turf), dirt below; dirt under it shows the fringe as its skirt (`sideUnder`). Its ramps are stored like grass's (`rampFamilies`).
blocks.name: snowy_grass

blocks.$comment: Leaves under snow (owner, 2026-10-21: "snow leaves"): the leaves' cutout canopy and light filter with snow on the top face and caught on the sides. Trees growing high up take it for their leaves (shared/worldgen/placements.json `variants`).
blocks.name: snowy_leaves

blocks.$comment: Prototype content (docs/BUILT_BODIES.md §3, owner 2026-11-02): the build platform. Placed, it starts a built body (shared/physics/bodies.json `startedBy`) instead of going in the world's grid: blocks placed against it join that body, which never settles back into the world. Its look is a blue grid (owner, 2026-11-18: "planks look exactly like build platform, we should change build platform to look distinctly different from planks").

blocks.$comment: Water running between basins (docs/WATER_FLOW.md §15): a spill over a dam, a fall down the other side, a stream to where it lands. Drawn and swum as water (the same fluid); the water flow draws it while an outlet runs and takes it away when it stops, and treats it as open: no basin is found in it, and a basin rising fills over it. Named by flow.json's `running` for its liquid.
blocks.name: running_water

blocks.name: dynamite

blocks.$comment: Dynamite with its fuse burning (docs/EXPLOSIVES.md): only lighting makes it; nothing breaks or overwrites it (`indestructible`) until it blows. Its light is the sputtering fuse (`dwell:fuse`, a small flame on its top) and its sound set's `burn` the fizz.

blocks.$comment: The wood ramp (ADR 0067 §5a, Phase 55 T2; owner, 2026-11-09): a felled log's cut cell split along its diagonal, never placed (not in the palette, not on the hotbar). The stump keeps the upright ramp (`half: bottom`, rising away from the notch); the falling trunk's new bottom is the matching upside-down ramp (`half: top`). A carrier like the log (the inverted one rides the trunk as a carrier, the stump's stands on the stump). shared/tools names it as the log's `fellWedge`; the axe chops it as the log (WORK_QUEUE item 26; owner, 2026-11-12: the stump keeps its gash): a hit bites it, never clears it, and it comes down once cut through, dropping the log's `buckDrops` where blocks are not unlimited; like the log, hands can't break it there (`breakWith`). Octagonal (Phase 55 T4; owner, 2026-11-09: "everything log/tree should be octagonal"): `crossSection: "of"` takes the log's, so the wedge is the log's octagon prism cut by its slant, in the mesh and in collision, its full end flush with the log beside it.
blocks.name: log_ramp

blocks.$comment: Plain snow (owner approved 2026-11-11, with the glacier ice): a block of packed snow through, white on every face, for high ground where no turf lies under it. The snow line's cover on a tall peak (shared/worldgen/rocks.json `tectonic.snow`). Shovelled quickly; drops itself. Its ramps are stored like grass's (`rampFamilies`). Prototype content.
blocks.name: snow

blocks.$comment: Glacier ice (owner approved 2026-11-11): old, compacted ice, a pale blue-white with deeper blue cracks and a painted sheen (glossy-looking but opaque: no new render path). On a tall peak it covers the coldest gentle ground and the crater's dome above the snow (shared/worldgen/rocks.json `tectonic.ice`, terrain.json `tectonics.iceBelowC`). Like stone, hands can't break it; a pickaxe breaks it in fewer hits than stone. Drops itself. Its ramps are stored like stone's (`rampFamilies`). Prototype content.
blocks.name: glacier_ice

blocks.$comment: Red sandstone (0.52.66, the mesa's red layers): bedded red rock, the face of shared/worldgen/rocks.json's dwell:sandstone, so a stack's sandstone layers read red on a mesa's walls and tops. Breaks and drops like stone. Its ramps are stored like stone's (`rampFamilies`). Prototype content.
blocks.name: red_sandstone

blocks.$comment: Basalt (lava V1, docs/proposals/VOLCANOES.md §6): the rock lava cools into (shared/fluids/lava.json `cooling.rock`), new land where a lava river crusts over. Breaks, drops and sounds like stone. Its look: the painterly `basalt` tile (shared/textures/materials.json, ropey pahoehoe folds). Prototype content.
blocks.name: basalt

blocks.$comment: Obsidian (lava V1): the quench edge, lava chilled at once where water touches it (shared/fluids/lava.json `quench.rock`). Breaks, drops and sounds like stone, harder. Its look: the painterly `obsidian` tile (near-black glass with a violet sheen). Prototype content.
blocks.name: obsidian

blocks.$comment: Lava (lava V1, docs/proposals/VOLCANOES.md §6): the cells the server's lava fields (crates/dwell-lava, shared/fluids/lava.json) hold molten. No collision (a player wades in and burns); written by the server only, never placed. `emits` is shared/fluids/lava.json's `light` (a test checks). Its look: the painterly `lava` tile (crust plates over glowing cracks), self-lit (`emissive`) and `molten` (the terrain shader's slow heat drift, off on the CPU tier; WATER_RENDERING.md §17). Prototype content.
blocks.name: lava
blocks.$properties: heat: the look's heat stop (shared/fluids/lava.json `heat`, hottest first; lava.mjs checks the values are the stops' names), written by the server as a column cools past a stop; hot (the default) is the look before 0.52.x.

Its species (shared/trees) names it as its `sapling.item` and says where it takes (`plantOn`); the server turns a placed sapling into the species' stage-0 tree and its growth record, so this block stands in the world only on a build without that species. A simple crossed-leaf look; drops itself. Prototype content.

blocks.$comment: The moon's ground (docs/proposals/MOON_WORLD.md M-1): gray dust over the whole moon world for now, the moon generator's one block (shared/worldgen/grids.json `block`; the maria take `dwell:moon_mare_dust`). Digs like sand. Prototype content (ARCHITECTURE.md §6.1).

blocks.$comment: The moon's darker ground in its maria (docs/proposals/MOON_WORLD.md §12 Q1; owner, 2026-11-12: "keep darker seas (add a dark moon aria dirt block)"): the cratered generator's `maria.block` (shared/worldgen/grids.json). Its `color` is also the far bake's albedo over the maria: 0.55 × the moon dust's luma, the old sky moon's seas (its shader's `1 − moon.maria`, 0.45), so the far moon keeps their contrast. Digs like moon dust. Prototype content (ARCHITECTURE.md §6.1).

blocks.$comment: Red-brown desert sand (0.59.0; owner, 2026-11-13: "We need a red brown sand for the red desert areas"): the surface of the red desert (the red rock mesa and badlands biomes, the sandstone's talus in shared/worldgen/rocks.json). Sand's physics, tools and drops in the palette's red_sand ramp; falls and settles flat like sand. Its ramps are stored (`rampFamilies`). Prototype content.

blocks.$comment: Ramps for every terrain block (0.59.0; owner, 2026-11-13: "we should support ramps for all terrain blocks"); after every earlier block, so earlier state ids stay.

blocks.$comment: Red-brown desert dirt (0.64; owner, 2026-11-13, of a Monument Valley photo: "Mostly reddish dirt though."): the main surface of mesa country's floors (the red rock mesa's bands, the red siltstone's floors in shared/worldgen/rocks.json), blended with red sand and tan sand by the mesa floor's ordered blend (rocks.json `blends`). Dirt's tools, drops and sound in the palette's red_dirt ramp. Its ramps are stored (`rampFamilies`). Prototype content.

Could add some single 'tree' block with brush on top."): leaves' rules (a rider, passable, cutout, filtering the light) in the palette's grey-green sage ramp; the crown of dwell:sagebrush (shared/trees/sagebrush.json). blocks.$comment: Town building blocks (owner, 2026-11-14: "Let's just do 3 blocks. Plank floors, stone brick walls, thatch roof. And doors also."): plank floors, a man-made block of sawn boards (the build platform's painterly boards). Combined from 8 wood (shared/inventory). Prototype content.

blocks.$comment: Town building blocks (owner, 2026-11-14): stone brick walls, dressed stone laid in courses (its own painterly tile in the stone ramp). Stone's tools; combined from 8 rock shards. Prototype content.

blocks.$comment: Town building blocks (owner, 2026-11-14): the thatch roof, bundled straw, with ramps (`thatch_ramp`, below) for pitched roofs. Combined from 6 sticks and 2 grass fibre. Prototype content.
blocks.name: thatch

blocks.$comment: The thatch roof's slopes (the stored ramps' shapes, placeable as the hotbar's thatch slopes, as stone's are): a pitched roof is ½ m and 1 m ramps facing down its eaves.
blocks.name: thatch_ramp

blocks.$comment: The door (owner, 2026-11-14: "2m doors."): 2 m tall over four ½ m cells, one wide, a column (`column`: its `part` property's values bottom to top, every cell of it the same door; BLOCK_REGISTRY.md, Multi-cell blocks). Closed it fills its cell as a block does (the doorway of a 1 m wall); open (`swing`) it is a thin plate against the cell's side, turned a quarter toward its `hinge`, with no collision. A Use (Place aimed at it, whatever is held) flips `open` on all four cells (`toggle`); villagers open the doors they walk through and close them behind them (shared/creatures `opensDoors`). Placed by its bottom part, facing the player. Prototype content.
blocks.name: door

blocks.$comment: A land cannon (docs/CANNONS.md C1; owner, 2026-11-17: "cannon takes up 4 blocks 2m long by 1m tall, shoots physics cannon ball in aimed direction"; "using the same input as doors, you can fire the cannon, clicking on it. It faces the direction of placement"): four cells, 2 along its facing (the barrel) and 2 up (`column` part, `columnAlong` 2), placed by its rear bottom cell with the barrel away from the player; a Use fires it (`use`: the server's cannons table, shared/cannons). Prototype look: basalt-textured cells. Density 1,500 kg/m³: ~3 t over its four ½ m³ cells, a real cannon's weight (2026-11-18: at solid steel's 7,800 it was ~15.6 t and heeled a raft over).
blocks.name: cannon

blocks.$comment: A cannonball (docs/CANNONS.md C2; owner, 2026-11-17: "Should have high mass as it's a heavy steel ball"): fired from a cannon as a one-cell body whose collider is a sphere of the ball's radius and mass (shared/cannons balls, by this block's name); at rest it settles as this cell, drawn as the sphere on the cell's floor. Prototype look.
blocks.name: iron_ball

blocks.$comment: Unused since 2026-11-18 (owner: "This cannonball design replaces the 2 types I specced out before"): no ball of the cannons data names it; kept in the registry only because removing a block breaks the compatibility line, and to go with the next one. Was the explosive cannonball.
blocks.name: explosive_ball

blocks.$comment: A ship's helm (docs/CANNONS.md C5; owner, 2026-11-17: "ship should be moveable with player controls, force should be exerted like a sail would, from the center of mass I think. Turning like you have a rudder."): on a built body, a Use puts the player at the helm (block data `use: helm`): their forward and back keys push the ship along the helm's facing from its centre of mass, left and right turn it as a rudder would, more the faster it moves through the water; jump leaves the helm. Placed facing away from the player (the ship's forward). Prototype look: plank-textured cell.
blocks.name: helm
